title: Nebula Serpent Apothecary
description: A vibrant purple cosmic serpent with iridescent scales coils around the wooden window of a mystical shop built into a blue stone wall. The shop features a hanging sign reading 'Nebula Serpent Apothecary' above a smaller oval sign advertising 'Spells • Elixirs • Cosmic Bindings' with address details, while potion bottles with glowing celestial contents sit on a foreground shelf.
prompt: A majestic iridescent purple cosmic serpent with glowing golden eyes and starry scales coils dramatically around the open window of a mystical apothecary built into a blue stone wall at night. The shop has a dark wooden sign reading 'Nebula Serpent Apothecary' with stars in the background, a hanging oval sign for 'Spells • Elixirs • Cosmic Bindings Slot 79 - Logan Sevin 0233-958', and glowing potion bottles with nebulae and serpent designs displayed on a wooden shelf in the foreground.
